Bowling score-sheet fixtures. Photos (`night_NN.jpg`) are real QubicaAMF end-of-night
RESULTS screens supplied 2026-08-28; `night_NN_truth.json` is the hand-transcribed
ground truth (every row is checksum-verified: sum(games)==scratch, scratch+hdcp==total).
`night_NN_ocr.json` (when present) is the cached Vision symbol dump so tests run offline.
